ApprovalDecision.description: The human decision on whether a verified patch may merge.

approver.description: Identity that decided, such as a Slack user id.
approver.title: Approver

comment.description: Human comment. Empty when none was given.
comment.title: Comment

ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision

ApprovalOutcome.description: The decision recorded from the human approval gate.
ApprovalOutcome.title: ApprovalOutcome

Evidence.description: One citation supporting a root-cause hypothesis.

excerpt.description: Short quoted excerpt. Empty when the reference stands alone.
excerpt.title: Excerpt

reference.description: Locator for the evidence, such as a path, URL, or commit.
reference.title: Reference

source.description: System the evidence came from, such as logs or git.
source.title: Source

Evidence.title: Evidence

FaultType.description: The kind of contract failure detected on a partition.
FaultType.title: FaultType

Hypothesis.description:
A proposed root cause for one incident.

``id`` is the value ``Patch.hypothesis_id`` must match.

causal_event_id.description: Change event the hypothesis names as the cause, if any.
causal_event_id.title: Causal Event Id

confidence.description: Confidence in this hypothesis, from 0.0 through 1.0.
confidence.title: Confidence

evidence.description: Evidence items that support the summary.
evidence.title: Evidence

grounding_violations.description: Evidence items or a causal id dropped because no tool returned that ref.
grounding_violations.title: Grounding Violations

id.description: Stable identifier. Patches reference this value.
id.title: Id

mechanism.description: Short description of how the cause produced the fault.
mechanism.title: Mechanism

Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

Incident.description:
A data-quality failure on one dataset partition.

``severity`` stays unset. The effective severity is ``IncidentCase.severity``.
``sample_failure_rows`` holds at most 50 scalar rows.

blast_radius.description: Downstream datasets affected by this incident.
blast_radius.title: Blast Radius

contract_name.description: Name of the data contract that reported the failure.
contract_name.title: Contract Name

dataset.description: Dataset the failing partition belongs to.
dataset.title: Dataset

detected_at.description: UTC time when the failure was detected.
detected_at.title: Detected At

failing_checks.description: Names of the contract checks that failed.
failing_checks.title: Failing Checks

partition.description: Partition key or path that failed.
partition.title: Partition

sample_failure_rows.description: Up to 50 sampled rows that failed the contract. Values are scalars.
sample_failure_rows.title: Sample Failure Rows

severity.description: Stays unset. Read severity from IncidentCase.severity.

Incident.title: Incident

Objection.description: One typed reason the critic refused the patch.
Objection.title: Objection

ObjectionKind.description: Why the critic rejected a patch.
ObjectionKind.title: ObjectionKind

Patch.description:
A code change proposed for one hypothesis.

``id`` is the value later verdicts, verification, and approval must match.
``diff`` adds ``remediations/<incident_id>.py``. The regression test is pandera-based.

incident_id.description: Incident this patch is meant to resolve.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

remediation_kind.description: Whether this patch repairs rows, quarantines them, requests a rerun, or escalates.

Patch.title: Patch

Postmortem.description: Incident report. The timeline is ordered by ``occurred_at``.

time_to_resolution_s.description: Whole seconds from detection to approval or escalation.
time_to_resolution_s.title: Time To Resolution S

Postmortem.title: Postmortem

RemediationKind.description:
How a patch tries to clear an incident.

Not every fault has a transform. Nulls stay null, and a late partition needs
a rerun. The fix step is allowed to refuse a code repair.
RemediationKind.title: RemediationKind

Severity.description: How urgently an incident must be handled. SEV1 is the most severe.
Severity.title: Severity

TimelineEvent.description: One entry in an incident timeline.

actor.description: Agent, human, or system that caused the event.
actor.title: Actor

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent

TriageResult.description:
Triage output after the severity floor has been applied.

``severity`` and ``final_severity`` are the same value. ``llm_severity`` is
what the model returned, and is unset when structured output never validated.

final_severity.description: The more severe of the model severity and the floor.

llm_severity.description: Severity the model returned. Unset when triage degraded.

prompt_version.description: Version of the triage prompt that was loaded.
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

severity.description: Severity stored on the run. Equals final_severity.

triage_degraded.description: True when structured output failed and the floor was kept.
triage_degraded.title: Triage Degraded

TriageResult.title: TriageResult

Verdict.description:
An independent reviewer's decision on one patch.

``round`` is the Fix/Critic round and must be from 1 through 3.

approved.description: Whether the reviewer accepts the patch.
approved.title: Approved

objections.description: Typed reasons the reviewer rejected the patch, if any.
objections.title: Objections

Verdict.title: Verdict

VerificationCheck.description: One deterministic check inside a verification.

detail.description: Short explanation. Empty when there is nothing to add.
detail.title: Detail

name.description: Check name, such as contracts or row_loss.
name.title: Name

VerificationCheck.title: VerificationCheck

VerificationResult.description: Pass/fail from a data replay. No model judgment belongs in this record.

checks.description: Per-check pass/fail list. Empty on older records.
checks.title: Checks

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay, in milliseconds.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

failures_remaining.description: Contract failures still present after the patch. Must be 0 when passed is true and greater than 0 when passed is false.
failures_remaining.title: Failures Remaining

passed.description: True only when failures_remaining is 0. False only when failures_remaining is greater than 0.
passed.title: Passed

remediation_kind.description: Kind of remediation this replay checked.

rows_checked.description: Number of rows the verifier replayed.
rows_checked.title: Rows Checked

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult

description:
The response record for a single incident.

Effective severity is ``triage.final_severity``. ``Incident.severity`` stays unset.

approval.description: Human approval decision, if the gate has completed.

critic_rejection_rate.description: Share of critic verdicts on this case that rejected the patch.
critic_rejection_rate.title: Critic Rejection Rate

critic_rounds.description: Completed Fix/Critic rounds so far. Maximum is 3.
critic_rounds.title: Critic Rounds

fix_attempts.description: Fix executions so far. Maximum is 3 (initial attempt plus two retries).
fix_attempts.title: Fix Attempts

hypothesis.description: Current root-cause hypothesis, if one has been proposed.

incident.description: The detected incident. Severity on it stays unset.

needs_human.description: True when the case escalates or the loop cap is hit.
needs_human.title: Needs Human

patch.description: Current patch, if Fix has produced one.

postmortem.description: Incident report, if the loop has finished.

triage.description: Triage decision for this incident, once Triage has run.

verdicts.description: Critic verdicts for this case, in the order they were recorded.
verdicts.title: Verdicts

verification.description: Latest deterministic replay result, if any.

title: IncidentCase
